content:
Not letting the new Mac mini and Mac Studio steal all the spotlight, Apple today also simultaneously launched a new version of its Polishing Cloth. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new cloth has actually dropped in price to US$9 (the old price was US$19).

There is no news yet on what changes have been made to this new cloth. Apple's product description for the new version is exactly the same as the old one:

Apple launched the Polishing Cloth in October 2021, and it was almost immediately sold out. Although it has become an internet meme, honestly speaking, it is indeed quite good at wiping Apple devices.

You can already order this "new" cloth on the Apple website today, priced at US$9. When I tell you to place your order quickly, I'm actually only half joking, because it really might sell out very quickly.

If you want to collect a piece of Apple history, the original Polishing Cloth is still available on Amazon, priced at US$19.
